_doc: LumaUI dock: an island tiled with insets (Dock, DockTile) and the sidebar's pane. Merged into lumaui by the generator: --lumaui-dock-*, LUMA_UI_DOCK_*. tile_radius is the kit's card radius (radius.island, Settings' grouped cards); an island hosting a dock is tile_radius + gap round, so the radii stay concentric. fit_max_pct caps a content-fitted tile (or group) at that share of the dock along its split.
